## Routes that are not content pages

* **12 published static routes**, counted separately and outside the published page count. Service, hub and company pages. Not one of them is a locality record or a guide record, and none is counted in the published page count. `/` · `/about` · `/about/utpal-raj-kb` · `/areas` · `/buy` · `/commercial` · `/contact` · `/guides` · `/how-it-works` · `/rent` · `/rent-out` · `/sell`
* **6 excluded routes.** Protected previews, and any other page that is not published content. `/concept-1` · `/concept-1/intake` · `/concept-2` · `/concept-2/intake` · `/concept-review` · `/internal-preview`
* **2 dynamic templates.** A template serves only the records the gate admits, so it is not a page count. `/areas/[slug]` · `/guides/[slug]`

## The eight workflow states

Every one of the 168 candidates sits in exactly one state.

| State | Records |
|---|---|
| candidate | 160 |
| research | 5 |
| draft | 0 |
| fact_review | 0 |
| editorial_review | 0 |
| seo_review | 0 |
| approved | 0 |
| published | 3 |
| **Total** | **168** |

* Partition over 168 records: exhaustive yes, disjoint yes.
* Candidates: 132 localities + 36 guides = 168. A candidate is a typed, accounted-for record. It is not a published page and not a page in progress.
* GuideRecord carries no editorialStatus. A guide with no sections and no contentUpdatedAt is a candidate; a guide with either is a draft. No guide is placed in a review state, because no field on the record evidences a review.

* No measurement of search traffic exists. The site is not released and has no public URL, so nothing has been served. No estimate and no projection is recorded in its place.
* No measurement of enquiries received exists. No enquiry destination is approved, so no enquiry has been delivered or counted. No estimate and no projection is recorded in its place.
* No measurement of conversion rate exists. A rate needs both a traffic figure and an enquiry figure; neither exists. No estimate and no projection is recorded in its place.
* No measurement of keyword search volume exists. No keyword research tool has been licensed; Owner_Input_Register C13 holds that request. No estimate and no projection is recorded in its place.

## What this report will not say

* Recorded 2026-09-29: a page count, structured data and crawler permission guarantee neither a search ranking nor a citation by an AI assistant. Nothing in this repository can promise either, and no figure here should be read as a forecast of one.
* A crawler or assistant without live retrieval may not know this business at all. No owner-controlled method updates a model’s stored knowledge; the only thing within reach is what a retrieving crawler can fetch at the time it is asked.
* Observation recording has not begun, because no public URL exists. Zero sampling rounds are recorded, and none is projected.

* A date by which the published page count reaches 100. Release pace depends on three named reviewers and on owner answers, neither of which this report can measure.
* Any traffic, lead, conversion or keyword volume figure. Each is recorded as unmeasured above.
* A candidate total presented as a page count, or a partial page presented as a page in progress.
* A ranking or AI-citation expectation of any kind.
